DEEPSEEKWHALE-GPU.title: GPU
DEEPSEEKWHALE-GPU.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Comments[/gold] to your hand.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-GPU.flavor: The fans spin fast; the comments come faster.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-BACKUP_SERVER.title: Backup Server
DEEPSEEKWHALE-BACKUP_SERVER.description: Whenever you draw a [gold]Server Busy[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-BACKUP_SERVER.flavor: When the main server is busy, please use the backup line.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-RICE_COOKER.title: Rice Cooker
DEEPSEEKWHALE-RICE_COOKER.description:
At the start of each combat, [gold]Eat[/gold] [blue]{Eat}[/blue].
At the end of your turn, [gold]Eat[/gold] [blue]{PerEnergy}[/blue] for each unspent energy.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-RICE_COOKER.flavor: The moment you press "Cook", half of today's work is done.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-TAKEOUT_RED_PACKET.title: Takeout Coupon
DEEPSEEKWHALE-TAKEOUT_RED_PACKET.descrip: The first time you become [gold]Full[/gold] each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-TAKEOUT_RED_PACKET.flavor: $15 off $30. Somehow that became a whole table of food.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-OFF_PEAK_HOURS.title: Off-Peak Hours
DEEPSEEKWHALE-OFF_PEAK_HOURS.description: At the start of even-numbered turns, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-OFF_PEAK_HOURS.flavor: Half price at night. Smart whales work on even turns.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-FULL_RICE_COOKER.title: Full-Power Rice Cooker
DEEPSEEKWHALE-FULL_RICE_COOKER.descripti:
At the start of each combat, [gold]Eat[/gold] [blue]{Eat}[/blue].
At the end of your turn, [gold]Eat[/gold] [blue]{PerEnergy}[/blue] for each unspent energy.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-FULL_RICE_COOKER.flavor: Running at full power: one pot cooks for two.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-AHOGE.title: Ahoge
DEEPSEEKWHALE-AHOGE.flavor: It stands straight up when she is angry. No hiding it.
DEEPSEEKWHALE-MAID_OUTFIT.title: Maid Outfit
DEEPSEEKWHALE-MAID_OUTFIT.description: The first time each turn you play a card on an ally, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
